title: 第25章 圆满层次的八荒掌第26章 对战武者境七重江钟
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
“什么叫太过分了？我说的是实话。”
江尘笑道为。
“江尘，你别太得意，如果你遇上我的话，针我会让你好看。”
江东冷冷地道。
“说得我会怕你似的，我倒是希望我们二人之间可以早点遇上。”
江尘道。
现在江尘的实力，不弱于一般的武师境强者，难道还对付不了一个武者境九重的江东吗？
江尘有信心，在武者境当中，他几乎是无敌的存在，起码在青月镇这个小地方，在武者境当中，没有人是他的对手。
至于更大的地方有没有，江尘就不清楚了。
世界这么大，一些极为厉害的天才肯定存在的。
江尘说完，就离开了。
看到江尘离开之后，江东安慰江凌道：“江凌，放心吧，我一定会好好地教训江尘，为你出一口气恶气。”
“那么就多谢你了。”
江凌露出一个难看的笑容。
当着这么多人的面前，被江尘一招击败，真是丢脸丢到家了。
“云风兄，想不到，你的儿子江尘的实力不错啊，修为应该不止武者境四重吧？刚才他出手太快了，我们都没有看出他是何等境界，不过，能一招击败武者境四重的对手，实力应该不弱。”
王家长老对江云风道。
“过奖了，江尘的修为是如何，我也不太清楚，大家安心地看着就是了。”
江云风笑道。
现在江尘大出风头，让江云风脸上也有面子。

有一个强大的天才儿子，谁不自豪呢？
“哼，这只是第一场而已，又不是得了第一名，有什么好高兴的。”
一旁的江海冷哼道。
看着江云风得意的样子，他就十分不爽。
“好歹也个一场首胜嘛。”
江云风淡笑道，根本不在意江海的态度。
反正要跟江海竞争族长之位了，不需要给他面子。
江尘的表现，也让不少的江家族人震惊，这个江尘的实力居然变得如此强大了，这可是一个强大的竞争对手啊。
接下来就是江东了，之前有了江尘一招击败武者境四重的江凌，出尽了风头。
江东可不想落后于江尘，同样一招击败了武者境三重的对手，获得胜利。
这就让江东的对手倒霉了，伤得不轻。
等到江东获胜之后，江海也是一脸的得意，他的儿子江东就是出色。
content_en:
"What do you mean it's too much? I'm telling the truth."
Jiang Chen smiled and said.
"Jiang Chen, don't be too proud. If you meet me, I will make you look good."
Jiang Dong said coldly.
"It sounds like I'm afraid of you. I hope the two of us can meet sooner."
Jiang Chen said.
Now that Jiang Chen's strength is not weaker than that of an average martial artist realm expert, can't he still be able to deal with Jiang Dong who is at the ninth level of the martial arts realm?
Jiang Chen is confident that in the warrior realm, he is almost invincible. At least in a small place like Qingyue Town, no one is his opponent in the warrior realm.
As for whether there is a larger place, Jiang Chen doesn't know.
The world is so big, some extremely powerful geniuses must exist.
After Jiang Chen finished speaking, he left.
After seeing Jiang Chen leave, Jiang Dong comforted Jiang Ling and said, "Jiang Ling, don't worry, I will definitely teach Jiang Chen a lesson and vent his anger on you."
"Thank you very much, then."
Jiang Ling showed an ugly smile.
In front of so many people, it was really embarrassing to be defeated by Jiang Chen with one move.
"Brother Yunfeng, I didn't expect that your son Jiang Chen's strength is pretty good. His cultivation should be more than the fourth level of the warrior realm, right? He struck too fast just now, and we didn't even see what level he was. However, he should be strong enough to defeat an opponent at the fourth level of the warrior realm with one move."
The elder Wang family said to Jiang Yunfeng.
"Excuse me. I don't know what Jiang Chen's cultivation is. Everyone can just watch with peace of mind."
Jiang Yunfeng laughed.
Now Jiang Chen is in the limelight, which makes Jiang Yunfeng look good.
Who wouldn't be proud to have a powerful and talented son?
"Huh, this is just the first game. It's not like I won first place. What's there to be happy about?"
Jiang Hai on the side snorted coldly.
Seeing Jiang Yunfeng's proud look, he felt very unhappy.
"At least it's my first win."
Jiang Yunfeng smiled lightly and didn't care about Jiang Hai's attitude at all.
Anyway, he was going to compete with Jiang Hai for the position of clan leader, so there was no need to give him face.
Jiang Chen's performance also shocked many Jiang family members. Jiang Chen's strength has become so powerful. He is a powerful competitor.
Next is Jiang Dong. Jiang Ling, who was defeated by Jiang Chen at the fourth level of the warrior realm with one move, stole the show.
Jiang Dong didn't want to fall behind Jiang Chen, so he defeated his opponent at the third level of the warrior realm with the same move and won.
This made Jiangdong's opponent unlucky and seriously injured.
After Jiang Dong won, Jiang Hai also looked proud. His son Jiang Dong was outstanding.
